official.deadline_note: Applications for the 2026 cohort closed on 12 June 2026; decisions and refusals are communicated by 12 July 2026 at the latest; the application portal reopens in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort.
official.application_cycle: Annual cohort cycle; portal reopens November 2026 for the 2027 cohort
official.status_note: The 2026 cohort application window closed on 12 June 2026; the application portal will reopen in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort application cycle.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Financial support: coverage of tuition fees and contributions to living expenses (HSG Best Talents Programme).
benefits: Support in further developing the potential of talented and committed students from Switzerland and Europe
eligibility: EU/EFTA nationals or holders of a Swiss C permit
Admitted to a Master's programme at the University of St.Gallen
Selection involves the HSG master programmes and a qualified, independent and diverse committee
requirements: Select 'Apply now!' on the HSG Best Talents page and submit the additional application documents
selection_criteria: A proven sense of responsibility towards society, the economy and the environment, and a diversity of perspectives
application_method: Select the option 'Apply now!' on the HSG Best Talents page and submit the additional application documents
official.application_route: Apply via the HSG Best Talents programme page once admitted to an HSG master's programme
official.citizenship_residency: EU/EFTA nationals or holders of a Swiss C permit
official.international_eligibility: Yes for EU/EFTA nationals and Swiss C permit holders; students from outside EU/EFTA are not eligible
official.description: The HSG Best Talents Programme, into which the Starr International Foundation Fund is routed, supports outstanding and engaged bachelor's graduates from EU/EFTA countries or holders of a Swiss C permit who are admitted to a master's at HSG, with financial support covering tuition fees and contributions to living expenses alongside a personal development programme.
official.program_type: Foundation-funded master's excellence scholarship delivered through the HSG Best Talents Programme

not_confirmed: funding_amount - no CHF figure is published for the Starr-funded awards
deadline_date - no fixed calendar date published; the portal reopens in November 2026
documents - the page requires 'additional application documents' without listing them
verification.notes: The dedicated Starr International Foundation Scholarship page returns HTTP 404 and the HSG funds-and-excellence-scholarships page no longer carries a Starr section or any CHF figure; the surviving official statement is the HSG Best Talents page, which states tuition-fee coverage plus contributions to living expenses for EU/EFTA and Swiss C-permit master's admits, the 12 June 2026 closure, the 12 July 2026 decision date and the November 2026 reopening.

applicant_utility.summary: This award runs through the HSG Best Talents Programme: if you hold an EU/EFTA passport (or a Swiss C permit) and are admitted to an HSG master's, the programme covers your tuition fees and adds a contribution to living costs. The dedicated Starr page is gone, so the Best Talents page is now the only official source - budget time to assemble the 'additional application documents' the page requires after you click 'Apply now!'. The 2026 cohort closed on 12 June 2026 and the portal reopens in November 2026.
applicant_utility.best_fit: EU/EFTA or Swiss C-permit bachelor's graduates with excellent grades and demonstrated engagement who have already secured an HSG master's admission.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you hold EU/EFTA citizenship or a Swiss C permit before investing time in the application
Secure admission to an HSG master's programme first - the award is for admitted students only
Prepare the additional application documents requested after selecting 'Apply now!' (the page does not list them)
Document engagement beyond studies and responsibility towards society, the economy and the environment
Watch the HSG Best Talents page in November 2026 for the 2027 cohort opening
common_rejection_risks: Applying without EU/EFTA nationality or a Swiss C permit
Weak evidence of engagement beyond academic grades
Missing the November 2026 reopening or relying on the closed June window
Quoting the dead Starr page's old CHF 20,000 terms, which no longer appear on any live official page
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs beyond the stated contribution, travel to and from Switzerland, health insurance, and any funding gap between admission and the November application window.
document_audit: The official page asks for 'additional application documents' without enumerating them - email the programme office for the current list instead of guessing
Transcripts must evidence the completed bachelor's degree and the engagement claimed in the application
alerts: The previously published Starr terms (CHF 20,000 per programme, English-language master's only) are no longer on any live official page - treat them as withdrawn
Decisions arrive by mid-July at the latest, so line up bridging funds before the autumn semester
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission to an HSG master's -> select 'Apply now!' on the Best Talents page -> submit the additional documents -> committee decision communicated by mid-July.
